mark.basis: 3 revisions; 1 of 18 sections were reshaped after introduction, and at least 36.0% of the final text survives verbatim from the first version

validation_scope: Validated on trace-commons (28 sessions, full transcript-to-git join, blame agreement ~100%) and local repositories; at-scale validation on SWE-chat (SALT-NLP, 17,968 sessions) completed Oct 2026 with a partial pass: bimodality reproduced approximately (agent-all mode 40.9% vs published 41%), pushback reproduced on the dominant agent (49.2% vs ~50% for Claude Code excluding first turns; pooled 39.6-40.7% and agent-mix-sensitive), survival not reproduced (metric-v2 aggregate 53.4% vs published 59%; per-agent survival 25-97%, so survival stays a context field, stratified by agent where known). post_first_prompt_share is validated as a steering-presence detector (SWE-chat medians: 0.0 one-prompt, 0.75 continued no-pushback, 0.97 pushback sessions), not a steering-dose measure; at SWE-chat scale it was computed as the gross-added-lines analogue of this field's final-lines definition (see swe-chat/VALIDATION.md section 6). Document mode ground-truth-tested on CoAuthor (1,447 human-GPT-3 writing sessions, CHI 2022): per-part 'unchanged from first version' labels validated (sentence-level agreement 88.3%, false-untouched rate ~0.05%); the doc headline % unchanged is a floor on the untouched share, not a dose estimate (mean absolute error 13.0 pp against keystroke truth, sensitive to revision granularity). Document receipts contain no rejection evidence: material rejected or dismissed before it ever entered a revision is invisible to doc mode, so doc-mode steering evidence is a lower bound on interaction (see coauthor/VALIDATION-coauthor.md).
